Support Specialist.label: Choose DROID/TECHNICIAN/TROOPER within 3 — grant free interrupt move

Terminal Network.label: While adjacent to a terminal: control all terminals until next round
Terminal Network.logMessage: **Terminal Network** — Until the start of next round, you control all terminals regardless of adjacency. Applies to mission objectives. Announce to opponent.

Terminal Protocol.label: Roll 1 green die; adjacent figures suffer Damage = result; activating figure defeated

There Is No Try.label: When a friendly REBEL FORCE USER rolls dice: set 1 die to any side + convert Dodge results
There Is No Try.logMessage: **There Is No Try** — When a friendly REBEL FORCE USER within 4 spaces rolls dice, choose one die and turn it to any side. On that die, convert each Dodge to 2 Blocks + 1 Evade. You will be prompted when a qualifying figure rolls dice.

Tough Luck.label: After opponent rerolls a die: remove that die from the results
Tough Luck.logMessage: **Tough Luck** — After your opponent rerolls a die, remove that die's result entirely from the results. You will be prompted after each opponent reroll.

Transmit the Plans.label: Grant 2 Hit Tokens to activating figure; if adjacent terminal, gain 2 VP (use /editvp +2)

Triangulate.label: Move friendly DROIDs, then pick hostile in LOS — damage = # DROIDs in play
Triangulate.logMessage: **Triangulate** — Move your DROID figures first (manual), then pick a hostile in LOS. It suffers Damage equal to the number of DROID figures in your squad in play (applied automatically).

Unlimited Power.label: When using Emperor: choose any friendly figure on the map instead of within 4 spaces
Unlimited Power.logMessage: **Unlimited Power** — When you use **Emperor**, you may choose any friendly figure on the map instead of one within 4 spaces. Play alongside Emperor; resolve targeting manually.

Windfall.label: When CCs discarded from hand/deck: gain VP equal to their cost
Windfall.logMessage: **Windfall** — When a Command card is discarded from your hand or deck, VPs equal to its cost are awarded automatically. When Windfall itself is discarded, +1 VP is awarded automatically.

Wreak Vengeance.label: When using Dual-Bladed Fury: choose both effects instead of 1
Wreak Vengeance.logMessage: **Wreak Vengeance** — When using **Dual-Bladed Fury**, both surge effects are applied automatically (play alongside Dual-Bladed Fury).

You Will Not Deny Me.label: Fifth Brother cannot be defeated; ignores conditions; recover 2 Damage on each hostile defeat
You Will Not Deny Me.logMessage: **You Will Not Deny Me** — Place on Fifth Brother. He cannot be defeated and ignores Harmful conditions. When a hostile figure is defeated, he recovers 2 Damage automatically and this card returns to the game box.

dc_pounce.label: Pounce: place figure in empty space within 3, then may perform an attack (free)

slam.label: Slam
slam.logMessage: Slam: Roll 1 red die. Choose an adjacent hostile figure — it suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. If that figure is SMALL, you may push it 1 space.
slam.rollOneDieNote: Deal Hit results as Damage to 1 adjacent hostile figure. If that figure is SMALL, you may push it 1 space.

force_lightning.label: Force Lightning
force_lightning.description: Choose a figure within 4 spaces and LOS — 3 Damage + Weaken; each adjacent figure suffers 1 Damage.

false_orders.label: False Orders
false_orders.description: Choose a hostile figure with a cost of 4 or less within 4 spaces. Perform a move or attack with that figure.

field_report.label: Field Report
field_report.description: Choose up to 2 friendly figures within 4 spaces with 2 or fewer attack dice in their printed pool — those figures become Hidden.

on_the_hunt.label: On the Hunt
on_the_hunt.logMessage: On the Hunt: Gained 2 free movement points — use the Move button. Your next attack automatically gains +1 Hit (tracked by the bot). Target must be a unique hostile figure.

shocking_palm.label: Shocking Palm
shocking_palm.description: The attack misses and the defender becomes Stunned.

concussive_bolt.label: Concussive Bolt
concussive_bolt.description: After this attack resolves, if you are targeting a SMALL figure and it did not miss, you may push that figure 1 space.

interrogate.label: Interrogate
interrogate.description: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a Command card. You may discard a card of equal or greater cost from your hand to discard the chosen card.

suppression.label: Suppression
suppression.description: After resolving a Ranged attack, if it did not miss due to accuracy, the target suffers Strain equal to the number of Block, Evade, and Dodge results, to a maximum of 2.

agitate.label: Agitate
agitate.description: If this attack does not miss, the defending figure's group must be the next group to activate, if able.

fell_swoop.label: Fell Swoop
fell_swoop.description: After this attack resolves, become Hidden, move up to 2 spaces, then perform an attack. Limit once per round.

spread_the_pain.label: Spread the Pain
spread_the_pain.description: Choose a HARMFUL condition not already chosen this attack. After this attack resolves, if it did not miss, a figure on or adjacent to the target space gains the chosen condition. Can be used multiple times per attack.

shrapnel.label: Shrapnel
shrapnel.description: Choose one: This attack gains Blast 2, or after this attack resolves, if it did not miss, each figure and object within 2 spaces of the target space suffers 1 Damage.

bargain.label: Bargain
bargain.description: Spend 1 VP to roll 1 green die. For each Hit result, gain 1 VP.

harass.label: Harass
harass.description: After the attack resolves, if it did not miss, the defender suffers 1 Strain.

squad_command.label: Squad Command
squad_command.description: Choose an adjacent friendly TROOPER. That figure becomes Focused.

critical_hit.label: Critical Hit
critical_hit.description: This attack gains Pierce 2. If the target suffered 1 or more Damage, the target may not play Command cards this round.

stalk_prey.label: Stalk Prey
stalk_prey.description: After this attack resolves, you gain 2 movement points and 1 Hit Token.

mastery.label: Mastery
mastery.description: Choose and re-draw a FORCE USER Command card of cost 1 or less from your discard pile. Limit once per round.

deadly_spin.label: Deadly Spin
deadly_spin.description: Apply -1 Dodge to the defense results. This attack gains Cleave 3.

fighting_knife.label: Fighting Knife
fighting_knife.description: After this attack resolves, choose an adjacent hostile figure and roll 1 red die. That figure suffers Damage equal to the Hit results.

stun_net.label: Stun Net
stun_net.description: After this attack resolves, if it did not miss, the target becomes Stunned.

wrist_cord.label: Wrist Cord
wrist_cord.description: Spend 2 MP to push a SMALL figure within 3 spaces adjacent to you.

wrist_flamethrower.label: Wrist Flamethrower
wrist_flamethrower.description: Once per round, spend 2 MP to choose a space within 2 spaces. Each figure on or adjacent suffers 1 Damage + 1 Strain + becomes Weakened.

bo_rifle_staff_strike.label: Bo-Rifle Staff Strike
bo_rifle_staff_strike.description: Once during your activation, perform a Melee attack using 2 red dice without spending an action.
bo_rifle_staff_strike.logMessage: **Bo-Rifle Staff Strike** — Free Special action. Your next attack costs no action and uses [Red, Red] dice (melee).

heroic.label: Heroic
heroic.description: Once during your activation, you may perform an attack without spending an action.

brutal_cleave.label: Brutal Cleave
brutal_cleave.description: After you resolve an attack during your activation, you may suffer 1 Strain to perform an attack using 1 red and 1 yellow die targeting a different figure. Limit once per activation.
brutal_cleave.logMessage: **Brutal Cleave** — Suffer 1 Strain to unlock a free melee attack with [red, yellow] against a *different* target.

smash.label: Smash
smash.description: Once during your activation, choose 1 adjacent hostile figure and roll 1 red die. That figure suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, if it is SMALL, you may push it 1 space to a space adjacent to you.

force_throw.label: Force Throw
force_throw.description: Suffer 1 Strain to push a SMALL figure within 3 spaces up to 2 spaces.

electrified_knuckledusters.label: Electrified Knuckledusters
electrified_knuckledusters.description: Once during your activation, choose an adjacent hostile figure and roll 1 blue die. That figure suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, if you rolled 1 or more Surge results, that figure becomes Stunned.

parting_gift.label: Parting Gift
parting_gift.description: Once during your activation, you may choose a space within 3 spaces and roll 1 green die. Each other figure and object on or adjacent to that space suffers Damage equal to the Hit results.

demolish.label: Demolish
demolish.description: Choose a space within 3 spaces and LOS. Each figure on or adjacent suffers 1 Damage. Place a rubble token. You suffer 1 Strain.

mortar_launcher.label: Mortar Launcher
mortar_launcher.description: At the end of the round, you may move up to 2 spaces. Then, choose a space within 3 spaces that contains a hostile figure and roll 1 red die. Each figure on or adjacent to that space suffers Damage equal to the Hit results.
mortar_launcher.logMessage: **Mortar Launcher** — Move up to 2 spaces, then choose a space within 3 containing a hostile figure and roll 1 red die. Each figure on or adjacent to that space suffers Damage equal to the Hit results.

charge.label: Charge
charge.description: Move a number of spaces up to your Speed. Then, you may perform an attack.
charge.logMessage: **Charge** — Gained free MP equal to Speed. Your next attack costs no action.

rapid_fire_ig11.label: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire_ig11.logMessage: **Rapid Fire** — Your next attack costs no action (2 attacks total for this activation).

rapid_fire_vinto.label: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire_vinto.logMessage: **Rapid Fire** — Your next attack costs no action (2 attacks total for this activation).

indiscriminate_fire.label: Indiscriminate Fire
indiscriminate_fire.description: Perform an attack. After this attack resolves, if it did not miss, choose 1 non-red die — each other figure within 2 spaces of the target suffers Damage = Hits and Strain = Surges on that die.
indiscriminate_fire.logMessage: **Indiscriminate Fire** — Click **Attack** to perform your attack. After it resolves (if not a miss), you will be prompted to choose a die for splash damage.

missile_salvo.label: Missile Salvo
missile_salvo.description: Perform up to 3 Ranged attacks with different targets, each using 1 blue, 1 red, or 1 yellow die (each color once). Apply +3 Accuracy to each attack. Limit once per activation.

battlefield_leadership.label: Battlefield Leadership
battlefield_leadership.description: Perform an attack, then choose another friendly figure within 3 spaces. That figure may interrupt to move up to 1 space and then perform an attack with the same target.

gifted_mechanic.label: Gifted Mechanic
gifted_mechanic.description: Choose an adjacent friendly DROID or VEHICLE. You and that figure each recover 1 Damage and gain 1 Hit Token.

wall_run.label: Wall Run
wall_run.description: Move a number of spaces up to your Speed. During this movement, you may ignore terrain in spaces that share an edge or corner with a wall.

ee3_carbine.label: EE-3 Carbine
ee3_carbine.description: When you declare an attack, you may spend 2 movement points to change one of your attack dice to a red die. Limit once per attack.

shock_and_awe.label: Shock and Awe
shock_and_awe.description: When you declare an attack, you may replace 1 Yellow die in your attack pool with 1 Red die. Limit once per round.

flawless_execution.label: Flawless Execution
flawless_execution.description: Before you declare an attack, you become Focused. If you are already Focused, you may gain 1 Power Token and add 1 attack die of any color to your attack pool instead of 1 green die.

foresight.label: Foresight
foresight.description: While defending, you may reroll 1 defense die.

arsenal.label: Arsenal
arsenal.description: Your attack pool consists of any combination of 2 attack dice.

epic_arsenal.label: Epic Arsenal
epic_arsenal.description: Your attack pool consists of any combination of 3 attack dice. You cannot roll more than 2 dice of a single color.

soresu_form.label: Soresu Form
soresu_form.description: While a friendly figure within 3 spaces is defending, it may reroll 1 die. If it does, convert each Dodge result to 2 Block and 1 Evade and, if that figure is not FORCE USER, you suffer 1 Strain.

inspiring.label: Inspiring
inspiring.description: While another friendly figure within 3 spaces is attacking, it may reroll 1 die.

hair_trigger.label: Hair Trigger
hair_trigger.description: At the start of a hostile figure's activation, interrupt to perform an attack targeting that figure. Limit once per round.
hair_trigger.logMessage: **Hair Trigger** — (Interrupt: triggered at the start of a hostile figure's activation.) Your next attack costs no action — click **Attack** to target the activating figure. Limit once per round.

figurehead.label: Figurehead
figurehead.description: Before a friendly figure within 4 spaces suffers Damage or Strain, you may suffer that Damage or Strain instead to prevent 1 of it.

executor.label: Executor
executor.description: When a friendly figure within 3 spaces is defeated, interrupt to move up to 2 spaces then perform an attack. Limit once per round.
executor.logMessage: **Executor** — (Interrupt: triggered when a friendly figure within 3 spaces is defeated.) Gain 2 free movement points, then your next attack costs no action. Limit once per round.

i_am_one_with_the_force.label: I'm One With the Force
i_am_one_with_the_force.description: At the start of a hostile figure's activation, you may move up to 2 spaces to a space adjacent to a hostile figure.
i_am_one_with_the_force.logMessage: **I'm One With the Force** — Gain 2 free movement points. Move adjacent to a hostile figure. (Trigger: at the start of any hostile figure's activation, once per round.)

return_fire.label: Return Fire
return_fire.description: After an attack targeting you resolves with no damage, interrupt to perform an attack targeting the attacker. Limit once per round.
return_fire.logMessage: **Return Fire** — (Interrupt: triggered after an attack targeting you resolves with 0 Damage.) Your next attack costs no action — click **Attack** to target the attacker. Limit once per round.

defensive_stance.label: Defensive Stance
defensive_stance.description: While defending, you may reroll 1 defense die. If you do, convert each Dodge result to 2 Block and 1 Evade.

overpower.label: Overpower
overpower.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 red die. While defending, you may reroll 1 black die.

vanguard.label: Vanguard
vanguard.description: While attacking a figure within 3 spaces, you may replace one die in your attack pool with 1 red die.

targeting_computer_hk_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_hk_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_ig11.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_ig11.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_probe_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_probe_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_sentry_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_sentry_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_sentry_reg.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_sentry_reg.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

charge_generators.label: Charge Generators
charge_generators.description: While attacking, if you have suffered fewer than 9 Damage, apply +1 Hit to the attack results and you may reroll 1 attack die.

expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.description: After you perform a Special Action, you may perform an additional action. Limit once per activation.

self_destruct_protocol.label: Self-Destruct Protocol
self_destruct_protocol.description: When you have suffered Damage equal to your Health, before you are defeated, you may move up to 3 spaces and roll 1 red die. Each figure or object adjacent to you suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, you are defeated.
self_destruct_protocol.logMessage: **Self-Destruct Protocol** — When you have suffered Damage equal to your Health, before you are defeated, you may move up to 3 spaces and roll 1 red die. Each figure or object adjacent to you suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, you are defeated. You will be prompted when this triggers.
self_destruct_protocol.rollOneDieNote: Each figure adjacent to you suffers Hit results as Damage. Then this figure is defeated.

self_destruct_probe.label: Self-Destruct
self_destruct_probe.description: At the end of a round, you may roll 1 red die. Each adjacent figure or object suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, you are defeated.
self_destruct_probe.logMessage: **Self-Destruct** — At the end of a round, you may roll 1 red die. Each adjacent figure or object suffers Damage equal to the Hit results. Then, you are defeated. You will be prompted at end of round.
self_destruct_probe.rollOneDieNote: Each adjacent figure suffers Hit results as Damage. Then this figure is defeated.

lasat_honor_guard.label: Lasat-Honor Guard
lasat_honor_guard.description: While attacking, after any rerolls, you may turn 1 die showing only a single attack icon to any other side.

hunker_down.label: Hunker Down
hunker_down.description: While defending, if you share a corner or edge with a space containing blocking, impassable, or difficult terrain, apply +1 Evade to your defense results.

battle_meditation.label: Battle Meditation
battle_meditation.description: Before you declare an attack, become Focused.

military_efficiency.label: Military Efficiency
military_efficiency.description: After you resolve an attack, you may choose 1 Command card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your Command deck.
military_efficiency.logMessage: **Military Efficiency** — After you resolve an attack, choose 1 Command card from your discard pile and shuffle it into your Command deck.

boltslinger.label: Boltslinger
boltslinger.description: After you resolve an attack during your activation, you may choose a hostile figure other than the defender in your line of sight and within 3 spaces. That figure suffers 1 Damage.

sidewinder.label: Sidewinder
sidewinder.description: After you resolve an attack, you may suffer 1 Strain to move up to 2 spaces. Limit once per round.

relentless_trandoshan_elite.label: Relentless
relentless_trandoshan_elite.description: When you declare an attack targeting a figure within 3 spaces, that figure suffers 1 Strain.

relentless_trandoshan_reg.label: Relentless
relentless_trandoshan_reg.description: When you declare an attack targeting a figure within 3 spaces, that figure suffers 1 Strain.

relentless_ig88.label: Relentless
relentless_ig88.description: When you declare an attack targeting a figure within 3 spaces, that figure suffers 1 Strain.

acp_scattergun.label: ACP Scattergun
acp_scattergun.description: While attacking, if you are adjacent to the target, apply +2 Hits to the attack results.

scattergun.label: Scattergun
scattergun.description: While attacking, if you are adjacent to the target, apply +1 Hit to the attack results.

cunning_han.label: Cunning
cunning_han.description: While defending, apply +1 Block to the defense results for each Evade result.

cunning_jyn.label: Cunning
cunning_jyn.description: While defending, apply +1 Block to the defense results for each Evade result.

cunning_nexu_elite.label: Cunning
cunning_nexu_elite.description: While defending, apply +1 Block to the defense results for each Evade result.

cunning_nexu_reg.label: Cunning
cunning_nexu_reg.description: While defending, apply +1 Block to the defense results for each Evade result.

fury_wookiee_elite.label: Fury
fury_wookiee_elite.description: While attacking, if you have suffered 5 or more Damage, apply +1 Surge to the attack results.

fury_wookiee_reg.label: Fury
fury_wookiee_reg.description: While attacking, if you have suffered 5 or more Damage, apply +1 Surge to the attack results.

distracting_han.label: Distracting
distracting_han.description: While a friendly figure is defending, and you are adjacent to the targeted space, apply +1 Evade to the defense results.

distracting_c3po.label: Distracting
distracting_c3po.description: While a friendly figure is defending, and you are adjacent to the targeted space, apply +1 Evade to the defense results.

sustained_by_rage.label: Sustained by Rage
sustained_by_rage.description: You cannot recover Damage. If you have not resolved an activation this round, you cannot be defeated.

deflect.label: Deflect
deflect.description: After a Ranged attack targeting you or an adjacent friendly figure resolves, a hostile figure of your choice in your line of sight suffers 1 Damage.
deflect.logMessage: **Deflect** — Choose an enemy in your line of sight to redirect 1 Damage to. (Trigger: after a ranged attack targeting you or an adjacent friendly resolves.)

regenerate_bossk.label: Regenerate
regenerate_bossk.description: At the end of each round, recover 2 Damage and discard all Harmful conditions.

full_of_rage.label: Full of Rage
full_of_rage.description: Before you declare an attack, if you have suffered 3 or more Damage, become Focused.

fifth_brother_relentless.label: Relentless Pursuit
fifth_brother_relentless.description: When you declare an attack, if the target is within 3 spaces, that figure suffers 1 Strain.

shared_intuition.label: Shared Intuition
shared_intuition.description: While attacking, if another friendly HUNTER within 3 spaces has line of sight to the target space, apply +1 Hit to your attack results.
